# Evaluation loader fixture

This tiny suite exists only to test the Offline Case Package loader, Suite Manifest
validator, fingerprint chain, and `eval doctor` CLI boundary. It is deliberately too
small to be a Formal Evaluation Suite and must not be used for runtime comparisons,
leaderboards, or claims about triage quality.

The future Formal Evaluation Suite will use a separately reviewed immutable version
with the balanced V1 case distribution defined by the evaluation policy.
